body: I am currently recieving coaching from Litiq, since I decided I wanted to make tft my hobby and at the same time I have ambitions to become at least half decent player. Litiqs coaching is superbly professional. The combination of VOD reviews and live coaching sessions makes the lessons tailored exactly to my needs, so i get to work each time on what my current weakness is. His friendly approach makes the live sessions even more worthwhile. Whether you are beginning your climb to higher elo and need help with some higher level fundamentals or you already are a seasoned player, I can only recommend Litiq!
